court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Shri. Sanjay Vithal Powar vs Sou. Sunita Sanjay Powar
facts_of_case: The Appellant, husband, has filed Hindu Marriage Petition No.430 of 2009 seeking divorce on the ground of desertion as per Section 13(i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The said suit has been dismissed and Appeal filed challenging the same also dismissed.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove desertion.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that in a case of desertion, the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove desertion.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant divorce on the ground of desertion unless it is proved that there was a reasonable expectation of cohabitation.
legal_principles.held: This Court holds that in order to prove desertion, it must be shown that there was a reasonable expectation of cohabitation.

outcome.final_order: Issue notice to the Respondent, returnable on 16th January 2023.

use_for_drafting: appealing a dismissal in family court
